info.title: AIStory API
info.description: AIStory — BYOK AI video generation platform. Users bring their own API keys; the platform provides the workflow engine, model registry, and video composition pipeline.

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: Maximum requests allowed per window (auth: 120, guest: 30)

Retry-After.description: Seconds until rate limit resets (429 responses only)

200.description: Dashboard stats (users, works, revenue, model usage)

get.summary: Deep health check — verifies DB, Redis, FastAPI
List model categories with stage mapping

delete.summary: Delete own account (GDPR right to erasure)
